title: On the Representational Geometry of Dynamic Programs
abstract: arXiv:2608.25034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard neural architectures often fail to generalize to longer inputs for dynamic programming (DP) targets. We investigate what makes this hard geometrically. Every finite min-plus DP is a shortest path on a DAG, which is equivalently a tropical polynomial whose extended Newton polyhedron encodes the decision boundary of which path wins. We prove these three descriptions (graph, polynomial, polyhedron) form isomorphic semirings at two levels --- formal polynomials and their computed functions --- connected by operations that characterize all structural redundancies. We then address the length-generalization question geometrically: does the decision boundary at length $T$ decide the boundary at $T+1$? We present two structural negatives. The semiring's two native ways to reduce dimension (setting a variable to each identity) are neither injective nor always closed within the DP. Series and parallel composition fail to construct all DAG

translated_title: 动态规划程序表示几何学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25034v1 公告类型：新 摘要：标准神经架构通常难以泛化到动态规划（DP）目标的更长输入。我们从几何角度研究这一难点。每个有限最小加DP都是DAG上的最短路径，等价于一个热带多项式，其扩展牛顿多面体编码了路径获胜的决策边界。我们证明这三种描述（图、多项式、多面体）在两层——形式多项式及其计算函数——上形成同构的半环，通过操作连接并刻画所有结构冗余。随后，我们从几何角度解决长度泛化问题：长度T的决策边界是否决定长度T+1的边界？我们提出两个结构性否定。半环减少维度的两种原生方式（将变量设置为每个恒等元）既非单射，也不总在DP内封闭。串联和并联组合无法构建所有DAG。
tldr: 本文通过几何分析证明动态规划程序在长度泛化上存在结构性限制，并提出两种减少维度的方式无法保证封闭性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals structural limitations in length generalization for dynamic programs via geometric analysis, showing that dimension-reduction methods are neither injective nor always closed.
